original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: ITC experiments were carried out at 5 °C with a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical). Each of the ATAD2B bromodomain proteins and histone peptide samples were dialyzed in ITC buffer containing 20 mM NaH2PO4, pH 7.0, and 150 mM NaCl. Calorimetric titration was performed by titrating each histone tail ligand (5 mM) with 0.2 mM ATAD2B bromodomain protein in the sample cell in a series of 19 individual injections of 2 μL, at time intervals of 150 s with a stirring speed of 750 rpm. These were preceded by a preliminary injection of 0.5 μL of 5 mM peptide sample, which was excluded from the data integration and calculation of Kd’s. To determine the heat of dilution of the titrant peptides in the binding buffer, control experiments were conducted under identical conditions. As part of data analysis, this was deducted from the experimental data. The obtained change-in-heat peaks were then analyzed by the Origin 7.0 program (OriginLab Corporation) and used to calculate binding affinities. Experiments in which binding occurred were performed in triplicate, while runs with no binding were performed in duplicate. The average of the three runs was taken as the mean Kd, and the standard deviation was calculated from the mean. The Kd values and standard deviations for the binding affinity of each ligand tested are reported in Table 1.
original_paragraph.Figure 1 caption: Figure 1. ATAD2B bromodomain recognizes acetylated histones. (A) Heat map represents the relative binding of GST-tagged ATAD2 and ATAD2B bromodomains to histone peptides using AlphaScreen technology (i.e., dCypher phase B; see the Methods section). α counts (n = 2) were normalized for each protein to the highest fluorescent intensity signal for each respective assay, and the relative binding strength is indicated by the color gradient. (B) Pie charts for ATAD2/B bromodomains indicate the number of peptides classified as positive binders (α counts having signals >5000, which is at least twice that of the relevant unmodified control peptide) (full dCypher peptide screen data in Tables S1 and S2, and Resources Table A). (C) Exothermic ITC enthalpy plots for the binding of the ATAD2B bromodomain to mono- and diacetylated histone ligands. The calculated binding constants are indicated.
